scope: Raskin and Auroux report surveys, atomic prerequisites, selected research statements, and explicit elementary proofs. This batch does not supply the analytic foundations of Floer theory or the complete geometric Langlands proof of the Arthur announcements.

raskin.reading_scope: Published HTML sections 1.1-1.3, 2.1-2.4, 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.3, selected passages in 4.5 and 5.1, and Lemma 5.1 in 5.2. AGKRRV1 sections 14.4.1 and D.1.1 checked for characteristic assumptions. Introduction 0.1-0.3 of arXiv:2603.26925v2 checked to separate proved zero-orbit statements from general conjectures and work in progress. CC BY 4.0 publisher license verified.

source_corrections: Closed-point eigenvalue formulas use q_x=q raised to deg(x), not q independent of the closed point.
Whittaker nonvanishing in Theorem B is existential within the same Hecke eigenspace, not asserted for every eigenvector.
Raskin's results retain announcement status; the 2026 joint preprint proves its stated zero-orbit result but does not supply every announced Arthur assertion.
Floer d squared equals zero is proved only after the stated compactification and gluing input; exactness alone does not establish all analytic requirements.
Surface restriction is a homotopy pullback, whereas covariant sectorial descent is a homotopy pushout. Nontriviality of cutting curves is retained.
Relative Fukaya deformation is formal; evaluation of a formal parameter at one is not asserted without convergence.

terminology.result: Banana Space searches did not provide usable results. Existing site vocabulary retained. Exact Lagrangian terminology cross-checked with Chinese mathematical lecture announcements, without claiming a complete glossary alignment.
